correctness.finding: PASS. Substituting λ=iω and introducing the mean/difference phases gives K+iω=e^{id}[K cos s+i(K_p+K_n)sin s]; taking moduli yields ω=2√(K_pK_n)sin s and comparing arguments gives the two-delay parametrization, with integer phase branches accounting for every nonnegative delay pair. For common delay the scalar equation λ+K=c_θe^{-λτ} gives the stated crossing frequency and phase gap. Implicit differentiation yields Re(dλ/dτ)=ω²/((1+Kτ)²+(ωτ)²)>0, so crossings are destabilizing. The monotonicity reduction in x=tan(θ/2) checks, selecting k=1,N-1 for N≥3; the N=2 modulus argument excludes finite-delay crossings. The switching set is a finite union over modes of countable analytic curves and therefore cannot contain an open robust neutral phase.
